description: We are a passionate team of students interested in AI/ML, software development, data science, and space technology. Our goal is to build an innovative, practical solution using NASA's open-source data within the NASA Space Apps Challenge.. We welcome skills in Python, AI/ML, web development, UI/UX design, data visualization, and scientific research.You don't need to be an expert—enthusiasm, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are what matter most.
summary: EarthTrend 3D is an interactive 3D Earth observation platform that helps users explore environmental changes across the planet using real NASA Earth science data. Users can visualize temperature, rainfall, vegetation, humidity, aerosols and wind, navigate geographical regions, and examine historical environmental patterns. The platform combines NASA GIBS satellite imagery with NASA POWER climate data and statistical methods such as the Mann–Kendall test and Sen's slope to identify long-term trends. Its geographical exploration system supports country, state and district-level navigation wherever boundary data is available. EarthTrend 3D makes complex Earth system data more accessible, understandable and explorable through an interactive scientific globe.
details:
EarthTrend 3D – Interactive Earth System Trend Explorer

Problem

Earth's climate and environmental systems are continuously changing. However, satellite observations and climate datasets are often difficult for the general public to explore, compare and interpret. Understanding regional environmental changes requires accessible visualization tools and reliable statistical analysis.

Our Solution

EarthTrend 3D is an interactive 3D Earth observation platform that combines NASA Earth science imagery, climate reanalysis data and statistical trend detection.

Users can rotate and zoom the Earth, select geographical locations and explore environmental variables through scientific visualization layers.

Key Features

  • Interactive 3D globe powered by CesiumJS.
  • Environmental layers for air temperature, land surface temperature, rainfall, wind, vegetation, humidity and aerosols.
  • Historical visualization using a date-based timeline.
  • Global geographical exploration with country, state and district boundaries wherever open datasets are available.
  • Location-based environmental analysis using NASA POWER.
  • Trend detection using Mann–Kendall statistical testing and Sen's slope.
  • Anomaly visualization and historical comparisons.
  • Transparent scientific overlays with dataset attribution, units and spatial-resolution information.
  • Responsive interface for desktop and mobile devices.

Technology

Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind CSS.

Globe visualization: CesiumJS.

Charts: Recharts.

Data: NASA GIBS, NASA POWER, NASA AIRS, MODIS, GPM IMERG and MERRA-2.

Additional geographical and wind resources: Natural Earth, geoBoundaries and Open-Meteo.

Hosting: Netlify.

Impact

EarthTrend 3D makes Earth observation data easier to explore and understand. It helps users investigate environmental patterns, compare historical conditions and identify statistically supported trends across geographical regions.

The platform emphasizes scientific transparency by communicating dataset resolution, temporal coverage, missing observations and limitations instead of presenting false local precision.

Future Scope

Future improvements include expanding administrative boundary coverage, adding more Earth observation datasets, enhancing regional trend comparisons and introducing more advanced environmental analysis.
